typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Owner as string,
		Modified as string,
		{Created By} as string,
		{SME Groups} as string,
		{Team Page} as string,
		{Next Review Date} as string,
		{Last Approved Date} as timestamp,
		Grouping as string,
		{Review Frequency} as string,
		Name as string,
		Created as timestamp,
		{SHRP Control Procedure} as string,
		{Certification Jira Ticket Number} as string,
		{iGrafx Process} as string,
		{EBPM Managed} as string,
		{Engineering Code} as string,
		{Control ID} as string,
		Notes as string,
		{Process Manager} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Owner as string,
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CreatedBy as string,
		SMEGroups as string,
		TeamPage as string,
		NextReviewDate as string,
		LastApprovedDate as string,
		Grouping as string,
		ReviewFrequency as string,
		Name as string,
		Created as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SHRPControlProcedure as string,
		CertificationJiraTicketNumber as string,
		iGrafxProcess as string,
		EBPMManaged as string,
		EngineeringCode as string,
		ControlID as string,
		Notes as string,
		ProcessManager as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Owner,
		Modified,
		CreatedBy = {Created By},
		SMEGroups = {SME Groups},
		TeamPage = {Team Page},
		NextReviewDate = {Next Review Date},
		LastApprovedDate = {Last Approved Date},
		Grouping,
		ReviewFrequency = {Review Frequency},
		Name,
		Created,
		SHRPControlProcedure = {SHRP Control Procedure},
		CertificationJiraTicketNumber = {Certification Jira Ticket Number},
		iGrafxProcess = {iGrafx Process},
		EBPMManaged = {EBPM Managed},
		EngineeringCode = {Engineering Code},
		ControlID = {Control ID},
		Notes,
		ProcessManager = {Process Manager}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
